mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plt_file_version (artifact_id, version_no, infra_file_id, availability_version, sha256, size_bytes, declared_media_type, detected_media_type, scan_status_code, scan_provider_code, scan_provider_version, availability_status_code, unavailable_reason_code, unavailable_at, version_note, created_by, created_at, tenant_id) VALUES (#{row.artifactId}, #{row.versionNo}, #{row.infraFileId}, #{row.availabilityVersion}, #{row.sha256}, #{row.sizeBytes}, #{row.declaredMediaType}, #{row.detectedMediaType}, #{row.scanStatusCode}, #{row.scanProviderCode}, #{row.scanProviderVersion}, #{row.availabilityStatusCode}, #{row.unavailableReasonCode}, #{row.unavailableAt}, #{row.versionNote}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, artifact_id, version_no, infra_file_id, availability_version, sha256, size_bytes, declared_media_type, detected_media_type, scan_status_code, scan_provider_code, scan_provider_version, availability_status_code, unavailable_reason_code, unavailable_at, version_note, created_by, created_at, tenant_id FROM plt_file_version WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND infra_file_id = #{query.infraFileId} FOR UPDATE
